description:
Surfaced during Phase 6 of the v0.3 layout migration (bl-d135). Two related
gaps:

1. crates/lernie-ui-egui/src/fs_watcher/mod.rs WATCHED_PREFIXES still lists
   .agent/goal.md, .agent/compactions, exchanges, invocations — all v0.1/v0.2
   paths. Per ARCH §3.5 the v0.3 watched set is: refs/heads/, the conv-repo
   root control files (manifest.yaml, workflow.yaml, providers.yaml, souls/),
   and per-branch worktree contents (goal.md, soul.md, summary/, steps/,
   descriptions/, skills/). Add v0.3 prefixes (and decide whether v0.1/v0.2
   prefixes stay alongside or get retired with the renderers).

2. crates/lernie-ui-egui/src/git_tree/* renders v0.1-shape and v0.2-shape only.
   v0.3-shape detection — bare <conv-id> branches under <repo>/<conv-id>/ and
   steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/ paths — is unimplemented. README §"UI (v0.5,
   skeleton)" already flags this as follow-on UI work.

Both pieces should land together: a watcher that fires on v0.3 paths is only
useful if the renderer can paint them, and vice versa.

Out of scope for bl-d135 because the strict-cleanup constraint there is
"small-diff string sweep"; this is real new behavior.
title: UI: v0.3-shape support (fs_watcher prefixes + git_tree renderer)
